---
title: "Scenarios"
---

The scenarios are designed for in-person practice with the Zoll. Use the public slides for learner review; facilitator-specific prompts belong in the instructor guide.

Each case now includes a brief resident/nurse-team interface prompt: who has bedside context, what the resident should ask, and how the plan should be closed-looped.

::: {.scenario-grid}
::: {.scenario-card}
### Case 1

Pulseless patient with severe metabolic derangements. Focus: asystole versus fine VF, the less-bad error when uncertain, and using nurse recorder/timekeeper input during rhythm checks.

[Open case](slides/case_1.html)
:::

::: {.scenario-card}
### Case 2

Pulseless VF/VT physiology with post-ROSC decision-making. Focus: first shock, persisting VF/pVT guardrails, post-ROSC stabilization, and cause search.

[Open case](slides/case_2.html)
:::

::: {.scenario-card}
### Case 3

Polymorphic VT/TdP after QT-prolonging medications. Focus: immediate unsynchronized high-energy shock for sustained polymorphic VT, long-QT/TdP recognition, and pharmacy/nursing medication-history input.

[Open case](slides/case_3.html)
:::

::: {.scenario-card}
### Case 4

Tachycardia during an RRT. Focus: rhythm interpretation, stability assessment, adenosine guardrails, escalation, and the first 30-second huddle.

[Open case](slides/case_4.html)
:::

::: {.scenario-card}
### Case 5

Bradycardia with hypotension and confusion. Focus: complete heart block, atropine limits, pacing pads, transcutaneous pacing setup, sedation planning, and shared preparation with bedside nursing.

[Open case](slides/case_5.html)
:::
:::
